response_markdown:
### Status: Handled via Dynamic Capability Filtering

Hi @author,

In **[Guidegram](https://github.com/DoctorGuidance/guidegram)**, we solved permission mismatch by dynamically resolving account tier and privileges before rendering UI controls.

#### Architectural Approach:
- Instead of querying static global catalogs, the client queries the active authenticated session for its exact entitlements (e.g. isPremium, chat permissions canSendMessages, bot commands).
- The UI selectively renders features based on what the authenticated account actually supports, preventing invalid actions and failed requests.

See how we filter capabilities: [DoctorGuidance/guidegram](https://github.com/DoctorGuidance/guidegram).
